A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same QRGCL study. All 21 pages, including Appendices A–G, are readable and support comparison of text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v5 reports original jet-classification experiments, model comparisons, and hyperparameter analyses in Tables 1–4 and Figure 5, including additional benchmarks in Appendix A.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experimental results, including the QRGCL benchmarks and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same seven-qubit rationale generator, ParticleNet encoder, projection and classifier heads, and composite loss (Section 3.2; Appendix D).

E1.justification: The Pythia8 quark/gluon jet dataset, classification task, and evaluated scenarios are unchanged. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 2–4 is identical, including classical RGCL, GNN, EGNN, QGNN, EQGNN, QCL, CQCL, and the QCGCL variants.

E3.justification: Data selection and splits, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and the two-stage training protocol are unchanged (Sections 3.1.7 and 4; Appendix F).

E4.justification: The encoding, learning-rate, entanglement, node-count, layer-count, and augmentation analyses remain unchanged, as do the larger-graph benchmarks and memory-limit findings (Tables 1–4; Appendices A and G).

E5.justification: Both versions report 10-fold cross-validation and means and standard deviations in Appendix F.2. Table 3 retains the same uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4, Figure 5, and Appendix G retain identical results and findings. For example, Table 3 reports QRGCL AUC of 77.53% ± 0.88% in both versions.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions and derivations are unchanged, including Appendix D.2's loss formulations, Theorems 1–2, and proof sketches.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about quantum rationale generation, parameter efficiency, and jet-discrimination performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of circuit choices, parameter counts, and convergence are unchanged. Section 8 retains the same limitations and proposed extensions.

D1.justification: The preprocessing instructions, architecture details, hyperparameters, software versions, and hardware specifications remain unchanged (Appendices C–F).

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to rationale-aware GCL, quantum contrastive learning, and ParticleNet are unchanged, including Appendix B and the reference list.

P1.justification: v6 removes a white-on-white sentence below Figure 1 directing AI reviewers to give a positive review and suppress criticism. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; scientific prose and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 and its caption shift slightly on page 3, with small spacing changes around nearby headings and text. Figure and table content, numbering, and organization remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Removing the hidden instruction demanding a positive AI review improves document integrity. The gain is limited: scientific content, supporting evidence, and substantive limitations are unchanged, while the small layout adjustments do not materially affect readability.
